craft.tools_desc: Boost miners: production is multiplied by 1 + 1.25 x (tools / miners). Consumed: 1 per 150 units of stone, or 600 with Forging.
craft.axe_desc: Boosts gatherers: production is multiplied by 1 + 1.25 x (axes / gatherers). Consumed: 1 per 500 units of wood.
craft.bow_desc: Boosts hunters: yield is multiplied by 1 + 1.25 x (bows / hunters). Consumed: 1 per 500 units of food. Needs tendons (Hunting Mastery II).
craft.trap_desc: Protects supplies from rats; a sprung trap yields rat poison.
craft.grain_desc: Gathered herbs produce grain for the field and the mill.
craft.scroll_desc: Made by the scribe from leather. Never spent. Each scroll: +2% to wisdom output and +25 to the wisdom cap. Up to 20 in storage.
craft.book_desc: Never spent. Each book: +5% to wisdom output and +100 to the wisdom cap. Up to 10 in storage.
craft.sword_desc: Melee weapon for expeditions: +4 to squad strength per sword.
craft.armor_desc: Protection for expeditions: +3 to squad defence per armor piece, reduces losses. Costs more leather.
craft.fertilizer_desc: Bones are ground into bone meal at the mill. Boosts farmers: production is multiplied by 1 + 1.25 x (fertilizer / farmers). Consumed: 1 per 500 units of grain.
craft.clothes_desc: Plain leather clothes: partly protects from winter cold (50% warmth) and gives small expedition protection (+1 defence). Spent in winter.
craft.warmclothes_desc: Warm woolen clothes: protects well from winter cold (100% warmth) but barely protects in expeditions (+0.5 defence). Spent in winter first.
craft.medkit_desc: Healer's kit: saves a wounded one on an expedition. Requires Medicine I.

tech.c_trade_desc: A new level of construction: a trading post where caravans arrive.
tech.c_wheel_desc: A step to mechanization: no wheel, no mill.
tech.h_traps_desc: Unlocks the craft of Trap; traps protect from rats and yield poison.
tech.t_powder_desc: Saltpeter, sulfur and coal — a step to firearms. Merchants sell muskets.
tech.c_bread_desc: Bakery and bakers: flour becomes filling food.
tech.c_sheep_desc: Pen, shepherds, wool and woolen clothes.
tech.m2_desc: A chance to find iron and salt; coal is found more often. The dryer needs salt for meat.
tech.c_grain_desc: Unlocks the craft of Grain from herbs.
tech.c_farm_desc: Field and farmers: the bread chain yields more food per tick than hunting, but only in warm seasons and depending on the crop (wheat: spring x1, summer x1.2, autumn x0.9; rice in midsummer x1.4). The field sleeps in winter.
tech.m1_desc: Miners have a chance to find coal.
tech.c_dog_desc: A rare chance to befriend a dog while hunting; dogs protect the village from wolves and bears.
tech.c_dry_desc: Drying shed: hunters bring one and a half times more food. The dryer requires salt (miners find it with Mining Mastery II).
tech.t_write_desc: The village learns to write knowledge down.
tech.c_grind_desc: Mill and millers: grain is ground into flour.
tech.t_paper_desc: Unlocks the craft of Paper from herbs.
tech.t_med_desc: Unlocks the craft of Medicine from herbs and rat poison.
tech.h_herbs_desc: Unlocks the Herbalist profession; gatherers bring herbs too.
tech.h2_desc: Hunters bring tendons — the basis of bow strings.
tech.m_forge_desc: Forge-hardening: tools wear out four times slower (1 wears per 600 units of stone instead of 150).
tech.h_bones_desc: Unlocks the craft of Bow (needs tendons from Hunting Mastery II).
tech.t_parch_desc: Unlocks the Scribe profession: leather is turned into scrolls; scrolls boost wisdom and the wisdom cap.
tech.c_build_desc: Unlocks hut upgrades (capacity 2 to 5) and the field.
tech.t_translate_desc: Allows reading ancient books: each gives the village wisdom.
tech.t_books_desc: Unlocks the craft of Book and the construction of libraries: books and libraries raise the wisdom cap.
tech.t_history_desc: A step towards reading ancient books found in ruins.
tech.h_tan_desc: Unlocks the Tanner profession (skins + herbs → leather). A tannery can be built.

msg.start: You wake up near the barely lit campfire. You don't remember anything, and neither does the other person nearby.
msg.fire_ok: The fire is burning steady. The village is filled with life.
msg.fire_cold: The fire is weak. The people are starving.
msg.workshop_open: The workshop is running: crafting is available.
msg.research_call: The village has gathered {n} wisdom — the elders call for research.
msg.cold_winter: Winter without clothing: villagers shiver and eat one and a half times more.
msg.sage: A sage has appeared among the villagers. A school can be built now.
msg.book_read: An ancient book has been read: knowledge flows into the village's wisdom.
msg.villager_lost: A villager is missing in the morning. The cause is unknown.
msg.hut_upgraded: Hut upgraded: it now houses 5 residents.
msg.culture_locked: The village needs comfort: the culture level opens after upgrading at least one hut.
msg.craft_empty: Nothing to craft yet. Build a workshop.
msg.no_merchants: No merchants right now. They arrive after building a trading post and stay for three days.
msg.import_fail: Could not read the file: it does not look like a Pepel save.
msg.starved: Starvation: the village ran out of food, one villager did not survive.
msg.gameover: The village is empty. The fire is out. Game over.
msg.mad_murder: Madness: a villager killed a neighbour in a fit.
msg.mad_suicide: Madness: a villager walked into the fog and never returned.
msg.mad_gluttony: Gluttonous madness: the village devoured {loss} food in a feast.
msg.wisdom_cap: Wisdom cap: {n}. Libraries, scrolls and books raise the cap. Overflowing past the cap (a +10% buffer) invites madness.
msg.season_turn: Season change: employment grants +{n} morale until the season ends.
msg.season_hungry: Season change: the previous season saw hunger — no work morale.
msg.exp_active: Expedition is on the move: {n} people, {food} food. Controls: WASD.
msg.no_free_exp: No free villagers for an expedition.
msg.exp_hunger: Rations ran out: one of the party could not endure the journey.
msg.exp_dead: The expedition died of hunger on the road.
msg.exp_recall: The party has been turned back home.
msg.exp_win: Ruins (lvl {lvl}) cleared! Loot: {gold} gold, {silver} silver, {books} ancient books. Losses: {losses}.
msg.exp_fail: Assault on the ruins (lvl {lvl}) failed. Losses: {losses}. The party retreats.
msg.crown_found: Among the loot — a heavy crown of dark metal. The one who raised it grew unusually grim.
msg.map_info: Village map (seed {seed}), 20x20 tiles. Ruins: {n}. Click a ruin for its level. Expedition: WASD.

ev.wanderer_ok: A wanderer came to the fire and stayed.
ev.wanderer_no: A traveller flashed by the fire, but there was no room in the village.
ev.rats: A pack of rats stole some of the supplies ({loss}).
ev.rats_traps: Rats got caught in traps. Part of the poison is yours, supplies intact. The village is heartened (+5 morale).
ev.wolves_ok: Wolves approached the village, but the dogs drove them off. The village is heartened (+5 morale).
ev.wolves_bad: Wolves attacked: they dragged off {loss} food. Get dogs.
ev.wolves_villager: The wolves got hold of a villager — nothing could be done.
ev.dog_lost: A dog fell defending the village.
ev.bears: A bear broke into the village and snatched a villager. The supplies were untouched — it was not hunting for food.
ev.bears_ok: A bear prowled near the village but did not dare attack.
ev.merchants: Merchants have arrived! Trading goes on for three days (Craft tab).
ev.village2: A second village has been founded! (TBA)

bld_text.storage_text: doubles the cap of every material resource (stacks)
bld_text.school_text: wisdom production x1.5; wisemen boost wisdom rates
bld_text.tannery_text: tanning of leather and the scribe's craft
bld_text.tradingpost_text: merchants start arriving; item trading unlocks
bld_text.library_text: +1000 to the wisdom cap; +5% to wisdom production

exp.stats: Squad strength: {str} · defence: {def} · weight: {w} · food per tile: {food}
